scenarios.title: Main page displays parameter input fields for API operations
given: The user navigates to the application
The root main page is accessed
scenarios.when: The user views the main page
then: Input controls for specifying API call parameters are visible on the page
An execution control to trigger the API call with the specified parameters is available

scenarios.title: Execute an API call with a single custom parameter value
given: The user is on the main page
An API call option requiring a parameter is available
scenarios.when: The user enters a specific parameter value (e.g. "12345") and runs the API call
then: The execution result reflecting the specified parameter value is displayed to the user

scenarios.title: Execute an API call with multiple custom parameter values
given: The user is on the main page
An API call option accepting multiple parameters is available
scenarios.when: The user enters specific values into each parameter field (e.g. a count "5" and a category "badge") and runs the API call
then: The execution result reflecting all supplied parameter values is displayed to the user

scenarios.title: Attempting to run an API call without providing required parameter values
given: The user is on the main page
An API call with required parameters is targeted
scenarios.when: The user leaves a required parameter field empty and attempts to run the API call
then: A validation message or indicator is shown prompting the user to supply the required parameter
The call result area does not present a successful operation outcome

scenarios.title: Attempting to run an API call with an invalid parameter format
given: The user is on the main page
An API call requiring a specific parameter format is targeted
scenarios.when: The user enters a value that violates the expected format (e.g. letters in a field expecting an integer count) and triggers the call
then: An error message or validation indicator alerting the user about the invalid input is displayed

scenarios.title: Re-executing an API call after updating parameter values
given: The user is on the main page
The user has previously entered parameter values and executed the API call with visible results
scenarios.when: The user updates the parameter value (e.g. changing "10" to "25") and triggers the API call again
then: The displayed result updates to reflect the newly supplied parameter value
